summary: Assess digital investments, design agriculture services and build a delivery roadmap. Explore practical agribusiness training and enquire today.
lede: Digital transformation in agribusiness helps managers, digital agriculture specialists and value-chain leads assess and prioritise digital initiatives. The course covers mapping value-chain needs, comparing investment cases, designing digital advisory services with the Business Model Canvas, and sequencing initiatives into a roadmap, while considering delivery risks and AI-assisted advisory use cases at a conceptual level.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape or deliver digital initiatives across agribusiness value chains. It is designed for people who need to connect technology choices with farm, processing, service or market outcomes.
modules: Value Proposition Canvas for Farm Services
prerequisites: Prior experience with agribusiness operations, agricultural services or digital projects is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use business analysis and spreadsheet calculations.
